text.content:
An international Free City on Del Coronado Bay, part of no nation.

Region: The coast of old Northern California, wrapped around Del Coronado Bay. The NorCal Free State to the north, the NUSA south and east, the Badlands between
Controlled by: Mayor Lucius Rhyne and the City Council; in practice the megacorps, Arasaka above all
The feel of it: Gleaming towers over a crater, crumbling megabuildings, and a Combat Zone a few blocks either way
Notable locations: Six boroughs and the Outskirts, eighteen districts: City Center, Watson, Westbrook, Heywood, Santo Domingo, Pacifica
Danger: Rated district by district in the Council's leaked NCZTA-70 reclassification

Founded in 1994 as Coronado City and renamed Night City in 1998. Under the Arvin Accord of June 2070 it is an international Free City, part of no nation.

At a Glance

  • Population: about six million inside the limits, and a million more in the Badlands and the camps. Nobody has counted Pacifica since the war.
  • Size: about 20 km north to south, 12 km at its widest.
  • Money: the eurobuck (eb, "eddie"). NUSA dollars change at a bad rate in Arroyo and nowhere else.
  • Law: the NCPD (Commissioner Ramos) and MaxTac (Commander Lorenzo "Contender" Lawrence); Arasaka Security on the Waterfront; Barghest in the Occupied Zone.
  • Transit: NCART, 8 lines with 6 running. Four bridges and a causeway: the Coronado Bay Bridge (Watson to Downtown), the San Morro Bridge (Japantown to Arroyo), the Pacifica Bridge (the Glen to Pacifica), and the Spaceport Causeway (Downtown to Morro Rock).
  • Net: the CitiNet, run by Night Corp from the old Ziggurat tower and audited by NetWatch.
  • Ports: the Port of Night City (a Free Port), the East Bay Terminal (rail), and NCX Morro Rock (air; the spaceport opens in 2072).
  • Languages: English, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, Haitian Creole, and Streetslang over all of them.
  • Nickname: the City of Dreams, if you're selling it.

The Free City

  • Citizenship. Anyone registered as a resident on the day of the Accord is a citizen. Newcomers apply at City Hall, or buy residency from a fixer for about the same price and less waiting.
  • Free Port. No tariffs on goods through the Port of Night City or the East Bay Terminal, which is why everything is for sale here.
  • Concessions. The Arasaka Waterfront is extraterritorial, and the Occupied Zone answers to nobody's law but Hansen's.
  • Passports. NUSA citizens need a visa to enter, and Free City citizens need one to leave.
  • Entry. Every official entry point means paperwork, a search, and a bribe of about 50eb. Nomad roads skip all three for a fee to the family that runs them.

Weather

The red skies of the Red cleared in the fifties. What's left is bay fog most mornings (visibility down to fifty meters), summer smog alerts, acid drizzle that ruins good clothes, hot dry Santa Ana winds in autumn that spread fires through the Combat Zones, and winter Pacific storms that flood Pacifica and ground the AVs.

Holidays

  • Founders' Day (late spring): Richard Night's birthday. Parades in the Glen, riots in Vista del Rey.
  • Accord Day (June): new in 2070. Free drinks on the Mayor's office, fireworks over the carrier.
  • Static Night (8 September): the city unplugs for an hour at midnight, and Night Corp throttles the CitiNet to emergency traffic. The NCPD calls it Remembrance Night. No netrunner dives that hour.
  • Día de los Muertos: Heywood's biggest night. The Valentinos keep the peace.
  • Lizzie's Night: the Mox's anniversary. Kabuki pours drinks, and every Tyger Claw stays home.

Media

Network 54 and WNS own the screens; Night City Today is the paper of record, and fixers read its classifieds. Radio: 107.3 Morro Rock Radio (rock), 89.3 Radio Vexelstrom (underground electronic), 98.7 Body Heat Radio (hip-hop and club), 92.9 Night FM (pop), 88.9 Pacific Dreams (ambient, in every corporate lobby), 101.9 The Dirge (hard rap), 106.9 30 Principales (Latin hits, Heywood's station), and 95.2 Samizdat Radio, a pirate that changes frequency weekly.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.15; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.00, 01, 03

text.content:
Key dates of Night City, from Lyle Thompson's Free City (Night City 2070, ch.01).

  • 1994: Richard Night founds Coronado City on Del Coronado Bay.
  • 1998: Night is murdered. The city takes his name, and the Mob Wars begin.
  • 2005: Corporate security ends the Mob Wars. The Corporate Center rises.
  • 2013: Alt Cunningham writes Soulkiller; Johnny Silverhand, Rogue and Lyle Thompson go into Arasaka after her.
  • 2020: Rache Bartmoss dies.
  • 2021: The 4th Corporate War begins between Arasaka and Militech.
  • 2022: Bartmoss's DataKrash goes off; the RABIDs tear the Old NET apart.
  • 2023: 20 August: the bomb in Arasaka Tower, the Night City Holocaust. Arasaka is thrown out of America.
  • 2025: The Time of the Red begins. Arasaka is caged in Japan. Michiko Arasaka cuts her deal with President Kress and founds Danger Gal.
  • 2030s: The nomads and the Co-Prosperity Sphere rebuild the city. The Tyger Claws reform.
  • 2045: Twenty-four districts, a crater at the center, a working Council. Ziggurat's CitiNet goes live. Trace Santiago's first Militech exposé sinks without a trace. Minako Arasaka is kidnapped and brought home.
  • 2047: The Night City Purge. Late August: the first Purge Ordinance. 1 September: the broadcast hijack and the Moon rock on the old Trauma Team tower. 8 September: Static Night, the Flicker, and forty-eight hours of blackout. Then the second Purge Ordinance and the four-night Purge-Riot. October: Santiago re-releases his exposé, and this time the country believes him.
  • 2049: Ziggurat loses the CitiNet to Night Corp. The first certified NetWatch trunks open: the Linkup begins.
  • 2051: Ziggurat is dissolved in bankruptcy.
  • 2052: The Hot Zone is cleared. Corporate Plaza is built around Memorial Park.
  • 2053: The New US Constitution is ratified. President Kress steps down; the NUSA holds its first elections. Militech clamps down on Danger Gal.
  • 2058: The bloodbath of Moto Cielo. The Valentinos rule the cartels.
  • 2062: Laguna Bend is flooded. A hurricane levels Haiti, and the refugees arrive in Pacifica. Agwe begins organizing them.
  • 2064: The Pacifica resort boom. Co-Prosperity Sphere factories open in Northside.
  • 2065: Rosalind Myers becomes President of the NUSA.
  • 2067: Lizzie Borden is killed. The Mox riots, and the Mox are born.
  • 2068: Night Corp buys NCART. NCX Morro Rock is approved.
  • 2069: The Unification War. Pacifica's investors flee. The NCPD takes Downtown from Whitewater Security. Michiko Arasaka leaves Danger Gal.
  • 2070: Operation Midnight Storm. June: the Arvin Accord; Night City becomes a Free City and Rhyne becomes Mayor. Hansen goes AWOL. Minako Arasaka takes Danger Gal.
  • 2072: NCX Morro Rock and the Star Line extension are due to open.
